title: pteretis pensylvanica
intro: Pteretis pensylvanica, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating wounds, reducing inflammation, and alleviating digestive issues due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Western Yarrow include its antiseptic and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating skin conditions and relieving menstrual cramps. Western Yarrow contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
